name: identity
title: Identity verification
summary: Verify a user's identity through Persona or manual staff review of an ID photo and selfie, and show a verified badge.

env.name: PERSONA_API_KEY
env.doc: Persona API key. Set → Persona hosted verification; empty → manual review by staff.
env.source: Persona dashboard → API → API keys (use the sandbox key outside production)

env.name: PERSONA_TEMPLATE_ID
env.doc: Inquiry template id (itmpl_…) new inquiries use. Required when PERSONA_API_KEY is set.

env.name: PERSONA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.doc: Signing secret of the Persona webhook pointed at /webhooks/persona. Required when PERSONA_API_KEY is set.
env.source: Persona dashboard → Webhooks → your endpoint (events: inquiry.completed, approved, declined, failed, expired, marked-for-review)

env.name: PERSONA_ENVIRONMENT_ID
env.doc: Persona environment id (env_…) passed to the hosted flow and to clients for the embedded flow.

env.name: IDENTITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS
env.doc: Rejected attempts before a user must contact support to verify.

env.name: IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_TTL
env.doc: How long a verification lasts, as a Go duration (8760h = a year). 0 never expires.

stitch: Decide what requires verification and gate it with identity.IsVerified (return identity.ErrVerificationRequired).
Show the verified badge where people judge each other (profiles, listings, messages) with GET /v1/identity/users/{id}/badge or identity.VerifiedSet.
Persona: create a template, point a webhook at https://<api>/webhooks/persona, set the 4 PERSONA_* variables, and name Persona in the privacy policy.
Manual mode: staff the admin queue; photos are deleted as soon as a decision is made.
Allow the hosted-flow return: web origins come from CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS/PUBLIC_WEB_URL, mobile uses scaffoldapp://.
